senses.gloss: f. ch. (סוּם I, cmp. שׁוּמָא) mark, spot.

<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Leviticus 13:2">Targ. Y. II ib. 2</cite> some ed. (oth. <cite ref="U00440"><he>שׁוּמָא</he></cite>). [<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 32:3">Targ. O. Num. XXXII, 3</cite> quot. as. Var. by Levita: <he>ס׳ דבית קבורתא וכ׳</he> (or <cite ref="O00683"><he>סִימָא</he></cite>) the mark of the burial place of Moses, h. text <he>שבם ונבו</he>; ed.
